facts.fact: The Ministry of Health's National Health Strategic Plan 2022-2026 states that health data capture is primarily paper-based, on a variety of often duplicating reporting tools, and that work begun in 2020 to implement an electronic health information system has stalled; the page gives no date for this position, so the document's published year is used.

The National Health Strategic Plan 2022-2026 names the eHIS in Strategic Direction Six, with 'Implement eHIS' and building one integrated Health Information System for the ministry among its priority areas; no costing is given on the page, and the published year is used as the date.

The Ministry of Health's own strategic plan presents the eHIS as the ministry's project, on its agenda for over a decade and to become one integrated Health Information System for the ministry; the published year is used as the date.

note: Classed hmis because this page describes the eHIS only as the replacement for paper data capture on reporting tools; it does not say the system holds patient records. The page also says there are no formal data governance standards in the ministry.
